confidence_notes: Meals, cappuccino and draft beer are based on current Lucerne price aggregates. Wine uses a local restaurant-menu median; the cocktail estimate follows its roughly two-to-one price relationship to draft beer. Accommodation is a holistic July high-season estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Lucerne-specific price benchmarks; accommodation reflects modeled high-season prices in Swiss tourist cities.
